description: This Kotlin file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter named NoteAdapter for displaying notes in a list within an Android app. It manages the presentation of Note objects, handles item clicks and long clicks, and updates the displayed data.

classes.name: NoteAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter implementation for displaying Note objects in a list with click and long-click support.

methods.name: updateNotes
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of notes and refreshes the display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NoteViewHolder by inflating the item_note layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the Note data to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of notes in the list.

inner_classes.name: NoteViewHolder
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to the UI components of a note item and binds Note data to them.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object's data to the UI components and sets up click listeners.

methods.name: updateNotes
methods.description: Replaces the current list of notes with a new list and notifies the adapter to refresh.
